problem: The hasBowSubregionCalculationCase relationship has no sh:minCount, so a ship can satisfy the shape without providing any bow subregion calculation case, applicability classification, formula inputs, or externally calculated bow shape coefficient.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the property for nltl:hasBowSubregionCalculationCase.
regression_guard: Preserve the requirement that at least one applicable bow subregion calculation case is represented before relying on nested readiness constraints.
